newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 dragged lower by turnaround on Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 dragged lower by turnaround on Dow.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index ended modestly lower in meagre volume on Thursday as investors decided to take a breather from the market's recent turbulence and UK shares shadowed a weaker performance in the U.S.
The leading index finished 11.6 points lower at 4,862.9, but managed to hold above the worst levels of the day after weakening on the coat-tails of the Dow.

The market had see-sawed between gains and losses all day, struggling to find a clear direction. Mid-250 stocks traded within a narrow 10-point range and ended 3.4 points lower at 4,478.4. SEAQ volume was a relatively slim 730 million shares.
